notes.title: Quick Update
notes.content:
Hey Dungeon Divers!
Random Dungeon  Game Demo has been updated, adding some new content and a few fixes. 

Added 1 new weapon for a total of 4 usable weapons.
Added 4 new rooms to spawn randomly in the level making the new count 40 rooms
Added some new visuals for the health bar and stamina bar
Added new visuals for the equipment menu for the equipped weapons/shield
Added new improved visuals for the portals 
Using "R" key to reset the level now resets the current level instead of respawning player in level 1

Fixed an issue where the player would spawn outside of the map at the start of new level
Fixed an issue where some rooms would spawn separate from others causing gaps making the player fall infinitely into the Void of No Return.
